export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/omzen-global-llp) states "Total Shipments 80 Records detected" and shows export rows, e.g. "2024-07-17 | OMZEN GLOBAL LLP | ELFY,LLC | DeWalt Part No DCD771S2 | MUNDRA SEA, India | Moskva, RUSSIA | 84672100 | BOL 2482802" and "2024-08-21 | OMZEN GLOBAL LLP | TRADING HOUSE \"ENERGOSPETSKOMPLEKT\" | FOODSCAN 2 LAB BENCH NIR ANALYZER ... | DELHI AIR, India | SHEREMETYEVO, RUSSIA | 90273090 | BOL 3379344". Counter vs rows seen: page claims 80 shipments / 2 trading partners / 4 ports; only 5 shipment rows were actually visible in the free view (4 dated 2024-07-17 to Moskva via Mundra Sea, 1 dated 2024-08-21 to Sheremetyevo via Delhi Air). Ports table: MUNDRA SEA 4, MOSKVA 4, DELHI AIR 1, SHEREMETYEVO 1.
note: Export direction is India -> Russia (Moscow/Sheremetyevo), i.e. re-export of DeWalt power tools (HS 84672100, 84671120, 84672900) and a lab NIR analyzer (HS 90273090) to Russian buyers ELFY LLC and Trading House Energospetskomplekt. Declared HS set 846721/846722/846729/850440 matches the observed tool shipments for 846721 and 846729; 846722 and 850440 not seen in the visible rows, and one observed code 90273090 and 84671120 fall outside the declared set — HS list should be corrected to the actual observed codes (84671120, 84672100, 84672900, 90273090). Role reads as trader/re-exporter, not manufacturer. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts) could not be checked: the web_search tool returned 'searx: Connection refused' on both attempts, so no domestic source was retrievable — recorded as unknown, not as absent. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free view: null. No CIN/PAN found in public sources; not invented.
